summary: Iteration 3: Verified the new Calendar view (backend GET /api/sessions/calendar + frontend CalendarPage) plus regressed auth/dashboard/activities. All 6 pytest cases pass. Frontend UI verified via Playwright against the public preview URL. `npm install --dry-run` and `yarn build` succeed without --force/--legacy-peer-deps.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~433 lines and dense (single-line handlers). Consider splitting into routers (auth, activities, sessions, calendar, intentions) as the file grows past 700 lines to preserve readability.

day_key silently falls back to value[:10] on exception, which would silently mis-bucket sessions across timezones if zoneinfo raised. Consider logging the exception and validating user's timezone at profile-save time.

calendar endpoint fetches up to 2000 sessions per call and filters in Python; when session history grows, add a Mongo query filter on ended_at using an inclusive UTC range derived from the requested month + user's timezone to reduce transfer.

Login button has no data-testid on /login route (only the form fields and nav items are testid-covered). Adding data-testid='login-submit' + 'login-email'/'login-password' would harden auth E2E tests.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of scripted calendar flow steps (login, nav, month label, grid, summary, active-day dot, detail panel with real data, prev/next month navigation, future-day disabled)

seed_data_creation: Created a handful of completed sessions on the test account via the backend tests (used as calendar-view fixture data). Also created one ephemeral TEST_ user for cross-user privacy assertion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend calendar endpoint verified: 401 without cookie, 422 on month=13, shape {month, timezone, today, days:[]} correct. UI verified against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Playwright signed in via role='button' name='Sign in' because the sign-in submit button has no data-testid — worth adding. The calendar summary correctly aggregates active_days / sessions / total_minutes and future days are disabled (25 future cells in current test month). Detail panel shows title, category tag, outcome, notes, and continued notes from real sessions.
